name: linalg_matrix_sqrth
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_matrix_sqrth(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Computes the principal square root of symmetric/Hermitian positive-definite matrices without mutating self. Tests cover real and complex dtypes, batched and empty shapes, noncontiguous lower-triangle semantics, output metadata, non-mutation, and invalid rank/shape/dtype inputs.
